# The documented StoreGraph counts the location once for AGG but twice for SUM.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-sql-queries.md
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.StoreGraphWithMeasure
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.Stores AS S, scalar_graph.Locations AS L
    PROPERTIES (id, name, population, MEASURE(SUM(population)) AS total_population))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.Stores AS SL SOURCE KEY (location_id) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (name) REFERENCES S (name));
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(AGG(L_total_population) AS total, SUM(L_population) AS ordinary_sum,
  ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * EXCEPT (L_total_population)
    FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraphWithMeasure') ORDER BY S_name) AS visible))
FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraphWithMeasure') GROUP BY S_location_id;
=> "{\"total\":1000,\"ordinary_sum\":2000,\"visible\":[{\"S_location_id\":101,\"S_name\":\"Store 1\",\"L_id\":101,\"L_name\":\"Anytown\",\"L_population\":1000},{\"S_location_id\":101,\"S_name\":\"Store 2\",\"L_id\":101,\"L_name\":\"Anytown\",\"L_population\":1000}]}"

# Observed with tools/bqanswers in both modes. AGG counts a matched key with NULL amount once,
# skips absent keys, and sums equal amounts for distinct keys while removing join duplicates.
CREATE TABLE scalar_graph.MeasureLocations (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED, amount INT64)
AS SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS amount UNION ALL SELECT 2, 100 UNION ALL SELECT 3, NULL;
CREATE TABLE scalar_graph.MeasureStores (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED,
  location_id INT64 REFERENCES scalar_graph.MeasureLocations(id) NOT ENFORCED)
AS SELECT id, CASE WHEN id <= 2 THEN 1 WHEN id = 3 THEN 2 WHEN id >= 6 THEN 3 END AS location_id
FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 7)) AS id;
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH scalar_graph.MeasureGraph
  NODE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureStores AS S,
    scalar_graph.MeasureLocations AS L PROPERTIES (id, amount, MEASURE(SUM(amount)) AS total_amount,
      MEASURE(COUNT(id)) AS location_count))
  EDGE TABLES (scalar_graph.MeasureStores AS SL SOURCE KEY (location_id) REFERENCES L (id)
    DESTINATION KEY (id) REFERENCES S (id));
WITH results AS (
  SELECT 'flat' AS mode,
    CASE WHEN S_id <= 4 THEN 'mixed' WHEN S_id = 5 THEN 'unmatched' ELSE 'matched_null' END AS bucket,
    AGG(L_total_amount) AS total, AGG(L_location_count) AS locations,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows, COUNT(S_location_id) AS matched_rows
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureGraph') GROUP BY bucket
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'nested' AS mode,
    CASE WHEN id <= 4 THEN 'mixed' WHEN id = 5 THEN 'unmatched' ELSE 'matched_null' END AS bucket,
    AGG(L.total_amount) AS total, AGG(L.location_count) AS locations,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows, COUNT(location_id) AS matched_rows
  FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.MeasureGraph', flatten_results => FALSE) GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM results ORDER BY mode, bucket));
=> "[{\"mode\":\"flat\",\"bucket\":\"matched_null\",\"total\":null,\"locations\":1,\"joined_rows\":2,\"matched_rows\":2},{\"mode\":\"flat\",\"bucket\":\"mixed\",\"total\":200,\"locations\":2,\"joined_rows\":4,\"matched_rows\":3},{\"mode\":\"flat\",\"bucket\":\"unmatched\",\"total\":null,\"locations\":0,\"joined_rows\":1,\"matched_rows\":0},{\"mode\":\"nested\",\"bucket\":\"matched_null\",\"total\":null,\"locations\":1,\"joined_rows\":2,\"matched_rows\":2},{\"mode\":\"nested\",\"bucket\":\"mixed\",\"total\":200,\"locations\":2,\"joined_rows\":4,\"matched_rows\":3},{\"mode\":\"nested\",\"bucket\":\"unmatched\",\"total\":null,\"locations\":0,\"joined_rows\":1,\"matched_rows\":0}]"
